_comment: NEGATIVE FIXTURE N02 — event out of order. 'Ship Package' fires before 'Confirm Order' (and before Pick/Pack). The field net's causal order forbids shipping before the order is confirmed and the item picked & packed; this ordering is not a linear extension of the POWL partial order, so the trace is off-language => RouteConformanceGap. Minimal counterexample: move 'Ship Package' to its lawful position after 'Pack Package'.
